alignments.note: Hiphil אָכַל rendered He would feed; subject pronoun and modal join the verb (rule 17).
Object suffix realized by them (rule 18); ASV pluralizes the singular referent.
Waw rendered by the postposed also (rule 51).
Construct noun takes the supplied the (rule 29). Margin 'fat' read and set aside (rule 38).
Rectum takes of; the supplied the on an anarthrous rectum joins it (rules 19, 15).
Bare accusative of material keeps only its own word; the with is the verb's (rule 33's מָלֵא case / rule 44).
מִן rendered out of, headed on out (rule 24).

Hiphil שָׂבֵעַ takes a double accusative (thee, honey); English satisfy reaches the material only through with, which is the predicate's own valency word on the terms rule 33 gives מָלֵא → full of, so it joins the verb's unit, discontinuous around honey and out of the rock (rules 44, 25). Competing reading: with on דְּבַשׁ under rule 33 as a supplied preposition for a bare nominal.

review_notes: Corrected: the second with moved from דְּבַשׁ to אַשְׂבִּיעֶךָ as the predicate's valency word (satisfy ... with), per rule 33's מָלֵא paragraph and rule 44's supplied-preposition clause; competing reading recorded in the unit note.
